action: In general, a standard system update will make all the necessary changes.
description:
It was discovered that SA-Exim unsafely evaluated the parameters of its
greylisting SpamAssassin rule. An attacker able to write SpamAssassin
configuration files or rules could possibly use this issue to execute
arbitrary code.
isummary:
SA-Exim could be made to run programs if it loaded specially crafted
SpamAssassin rules.

sa-exim.description: Use SpamAssassin at SMTP time with the Exim v4 MTA

title: SA-Exim vulnerability
